The first release of n2den, an experimental Nintendo Switch 2 recompulator built on Eden.

n2den runs decrypted dumps of games you own. It contains no decryption code, does not use console keys, and includes no games.

## Downloads

| Package | What it is |
|---|---|
| `n2Den-v1.0.0-windows-x64-pgo.zip` | **Recommended.** Built with clang, ThinLTO and a profile trained on gameplay: the faster build. The command-line `n2Den-cli.exe` is only in the MSVC package. |
| `n2Den-v1.0.0-windows-x64.zip` | The same source built with MSVC, like the test builds. Use it if the PGO build misbehaves on your machine. |
| `*-symbols.zip` | Debug symbols for crash reports. Not needed to play. |

Windows x64 with a Vulkan GPU. Extract into a new folder; create an empty `user` folder beside `n2Den.exe` for portable mode. No launch switches or environment variables are needed.

## Highlights

- **Native Ampere shader front end:** the Switch 2 GPU's own shader programs, including task and mesh shaders, are translated as Ampere.
- **Two graphics backends, chosen per game:** Emulated GPU (default), where the game's own NVN driver runs on emulated hardware, and NVN-HLE (experimental), which replays the game's NVN calls on Vulkan.
- **Prepared launch:** "Precompile CPU code" compiles a game's CPU code when it boots, and under NVN-HLE the graphics pipelines a game is known to use can be built before play.
- **Dynarmic NX2:** the CPU recompiler extended for the Switch 2's Cortex-A78C, with a persistent JIT disk cache.
- **In-game movies:** AV1, H.264 and VP9.
- Built-in Dynamic FPS and Max Resolution patches for Ocarina of Time.
- A performance overlay, and a debug server with MCP tools for inspecting a running game.

## Tested games

| Game | Emulated GPU | NVN-HLE (Vulkan) |
|---|---|---|
| The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2) | In-game | In-game |
| Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave | In-game | In-game |
| Fast Fusion | Playable | Playable |
| Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World | Playable | Playable |
| Nintendo Switch Sports Resort | Not tested | Boots |
| Mario Kart World | Not tested | Unstable |

Details and known issues per game: [docs/GameProgress.md](https://github.com/Duck912/n2den/blob/main/docs/GameProgress.md). Games not in the table have not been tested.

## Known issues

- Expect missing graphics and crashes: this is a development release.
- The first time a new area or effect appears there is a short stutter while its shaders build; later runs reuse the cache.
- Mario Kart World can run out of system RAM after several minutes and is not recommended for play.
- Only Windows is supported for now.

## Reporting problems

Open an issue with `user\log\eden_log.txt` (or `%APPDATA%\eden\log\eden_log.txt`), taken right after the problem, plus your GPU and driver version.
